brief:
The Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza reported four deaths and 28 injuries at hospitals over the past 24 hours on October 8, 2026, Eye on Palestine said. The new casualties add to tolls recorded since a ceasefire took effect on October 11, 2025.

Since the ceasefire began, the ministry has documented 1,471 deaths and 5,189 injuries across the Gaza Strip.

title: Gaza health ministry reports four deaths, 28 wounded in 24 hours
